description.value: Moby Dick is a family-operated, award-winning fish and chips landmark on White Rock's East Beach, open since 1975 and decorated throughout with whale memorabilia and suspended fish nets. Situated directly on Marine Drive across from the totem poles, it offers both dine-in and takeout with a licensed heated outdoor nautical patio overlooking the waterfront. A multiple People's Choice Award winner for best fish and chips on the peninsula, it is a natural stopping point for cyclists riding the White Rock seawall.

No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
